neighbours.label: The copula (or the word right after it) in a sentence that defines a term: 'Homophones are words that…', 'A blastomere is simply a cell…', as opposed to a copula that states a temporary state, time or place.
fire: Synonyms are words that have the same or nearly the same meaning.
A haiku is a short poem with three lines and seventeen syllables.
Compost is simply decayed plant matter that enriches the soil.
Prime numbers are numbers that can only be divided by one and themselves.
A delta is a landform made of sediment at the mouth of a river.
Adjectives are words that describe or modify nouns.
An isotope is basically an atom with a different number of neutrons.
Fossils are the preserved remains or traces of ancient organisms.
quiet: The synonyms on the worksheet are hard to read because the ink is faded.
The haiku club is at four o'clock in the library.
The compost is still too wet to spread on the garden.
The prime numbers on the board were written by the teacher.
The delta was flooded for most of last spring.
The adjectives in her essay are a bit repetitive.
The isotope samples are in the freezer downstairs.
The fossils were in the museum basement for years.
